AI Overview
Tradle is a daily geography and economics guessing game created by the Observatory of Economic Complexity (OEC Games). 
The Observatory of Economic Complexity
 +1
How to Play
Objective: Guess the mystery country based on its export treemap within six attempts. 
The Clue: You see colored blocks representing top export products sized by their share of total exports (such as petroleum, cars, or machinery). 
Feedback: After each guess, the game gives you the distance in kilometers, a directional arrow, and a proximity percentage. 
Reset: A new daily challenge becomes available at midnight in your local timezone. You can also play unlimited puzzles in practice mode. 
You can play the official daily game on the Tradle Website or explore regional versions like US states and European provinces through OEC Games.
